# The quest tree

<!-- Generated by tools/quest_tree.py from the shipped questlines. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page is generated from the content itself, so the numbers below are what the mod actually loads. Every trail is one JSON file in `src/main/resources/assets/hangulquest/data/questlines/`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Questlines | **422** |
| Steps (incl. finales) | **1569** |
| Tree levels | **22** |
| Roots | 39 |
| Merges (more than one parent) | 129 |
| Vocabulary | 293 hand-written concepts, generated entries for the rarer objects, vanilla names and the Lute import |

A trail's `koreanLevel` is the TOPIK band of its depth: levels 1–3 speak polite Korean, 4–6 add obligation, 7–9 emphatic forms, 10–12 the double negative, 13–15 literary forms and 16 and deeper the `-(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없어요` band.

## Reading the tree

- **Roots** have no `requires.completed`. There are several so a new player can start in the branch that matches what they are doing anyway.
- **Merges** (a trail with two or more parents) are the interesting nodes: they only unlock when every parent is finished, which is what turns a list of questlines into a tree.
- **Hints never leave level 1.** A late trail speaks literary Korean; pressing `H` restates the same task in polite Korean, so the ladder never blocks you.
- **The ritual finale is the guarantee.** Every trail ends with an action you can always perform — a torch at night, a campfire on a beach — never a structure or a coordinate.
